argument: One faceted loop must read as a single self-contained body with a dark aperture before it reads as a torus primitive. Unequal depth, a broken interior rim, and asymmetrical face rhythm must carry the image without interface chrome.

With readout, controls, labels, hint, and prose hidden, the first view must leave v042-v044's field, slab, and register grammars. It should read as a self-producing object, not a generic 3D loop or ribbon sculpture.

The viewer must enclose the object and complete a closure, not select a panel, cross a channel, or leave a field. Pointer, touch, deterministic control, and keyboard must offer equivalent meaningful paths.

An open or cancelled trace must remain geometry-neutral. A closed trace must change actual volume, aperture, depth, shear, phase, and facet rhythm; readout and colour cannot substitute for produced geometry.
Clockwise and counter-clockwise closure must produce materially different form states. If direction only changes a label, the translation fails.
Four compilations must compound in one loop. Lift must reconstruct the exact preceding form and release must return to the deterministic quiet seed.
Generated p5.js WEBGL facets, depth, inner aperture, and seeded geometry are the medium. No screenshot, imported model, external font, or decorative particle library may carry the work.

p5.brush is translated from material production rules into closure-driven self-compilation. No brush preset, watercolor, hatching, grain, source palette, composition, source code, example, or API surface is reproduced.

v045 changes representation, composition, encounter, temporal behaviour, and viewer task: the recent remote field grammar becomes one WebGL object whose own production rule is rewritten by a completed enclosure.
Delete v045 if an open trace compiles, if winding is cosmetic, if the body is only a generic torus, if later compilations reset, if the trace paints a local scar, or if exact lifting fails.
